A privacy disaster surfaced. https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/11/a-leaky-ai-supply-chain-is-exposing-secret-user-data-at-an-alarming-rate/ https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/11/a-leaky-ai-supply-chain-is-exposing-secret-user-data-at-an-alarming-rate/#comments Fri, 20 Nov 2026 20:59:08 +0000 https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/11/a-leaky-ai-supply-chain-is-exposing-secret-user-data-at-an-alarming-rate/ Researchers planted 2 million digital tripwires in requests sent through a sprawling network of AI services to find out what happened to sensitive information entrusted to them. What they discovered was an ecosystem that leaked highly sensitive data like a sieve.

The exposure was found through an ingenious experiment designed to test if sensitive information can leak through the vast chain of widely used AI services and how that information is exploited when it does. Many of today’s AI apps use services such as OpenRouter or Vercel that act as brokers. These “AI routers,” sometimes also known as “AI gateways,” receive large numbers of prompts sent from AI app end users and route them to an available inference engine based on criteria such as the one charging the lowest price or being best suited for the given task. Instead of using Anthropic, OpenAI, or another big provider, the developer hires an AI router to find the most suitable model.

Some pairs of stars orbit so close to each other that they could not have formed at that distance, so their orbits must have shrunk. Common envelope evolution is the leading explanation for that shrinkage. When one star in a binary grows old, it expands into a giant, and its outer layers can engulf its companion. The two then share a single, loosely bound envelope of gas. As the engulfed star drags through it, it loses orbital energy to friction and spirals inward. Depending on how much of the envelope gets lost, the pair either ends up in a much tighter orbit or merges.

    About us

    At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

    The role

    Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.

    You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.

    You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.

    Key responsibilities

    • Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

    • Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

    • Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

    • Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

    • Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

    • Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

    • Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

    • Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

    • Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

    • Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

    • Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

    • Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

    Your background

    You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:

    • A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

    • Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

    • Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

    • A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

    • A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

    • Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

    You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦

    • Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, iterating quickly, and fixing things before they become fires;

    • Stay Human. You care deeply about users and teammates, and design with empathy for real workflows;

    • Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You spot problems early and take initiative to fix them.

    • Keep It Simple. You fight unnecessary complexity, design reusable patterns, and make hard things feel intuitive.

    • Love to Surprise. You enjoy finding unexpected ways to delight users, especially in the last mile of polish and usability.

    KPIs & Success Measures

    We will measure success through outcomes and quality, not just output:

    • Builder share (lead): percentage of monthly active users who build or edit a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

    • Workflow adoption (lead): percentage of monthly active users who run a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

    • Workflow run growth: month-on-month percentage growth in workflow runs. Target [TBD]%.

    • First workflow conversion: percentage of new users who complete a successful run within their first [TBD] days.

    • Share of generations through workflows: percentage of all generations produced by workflow runs.

    • Agent and human collaboration: percentage of workflow runs built or started by Scribble.

    • Connector adoption: percentage of active workspaces that use at least one third-party connection in a workflow each month. Target [TBD]%.

    • Integration usage: percentage of workflow runs that start from, or deliver to, a third-party connection. Target [TBD]%.

    • Reliability (hygiene bar): percentage of runs that complete without manual intervention, held at or above [TBD]%.

    • Learning velocity (supporting): percentage of launches reviewed after release against their stated hypothesis. Target 100%.

    Benefits

    • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

    • Health insurance / private medical cover

    • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

    • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

    • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

    • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for our UK employees

    About Claims

    AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

    We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor.     • Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.

    We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are looking for a Senior Technical Programme Manager who can turn a complex, multi-team technical programme into a plan people trust and deliver against.

You will work closely with your Engineering Manager to shape direction, manage dependencies across pillars, and ensure the programme meets the standards a regulated payments business demands.

  • A track record of delivering large infrastructure or platform programmes: a cloud migration, a new region, a cloud landing zone build, a data centre exit, or similar infrastructure related project within a fast paced technology environment

  • Enough technical depth to hold your own with engineers.   • Experience working with cloud providers and partners to align their support and funding with your delivery plan, ideally Azure alongside AWS

  • Product thinking applied to internal platforms: you have treated engineering teams as customers, worked out what they need, and measured whether they adopted it.

  • Proven ability to get commitments from teams and leaders who don't report to you.

  • Experience in a regulated environment, such as financial services or payments

  • Own the roadmap. Understand what product engineering teams need before they can deploy into Azure or a new cloud region, help decide which paved roads come first, and set adoption measures we can report on.

About CodeRabbit

CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship.

We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge.

CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion.

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution.

  • Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

  • Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

  • Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

  • Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

About Us

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.


We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe.

About the Role

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)

  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more.   • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on.

These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions.

Responsibilities

  • Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control

  • Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment.

  • Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines.

  • Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

  • Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions.

  • Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment.

Candidates Requirements

  • Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus.

  • Technical skills: Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus.

  • Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Jouw impact als Senior Social & AI Marketeer

Als Senior Social & AI Marketeer bij Indicia ben je het strategische aanspreekpunt voor grote klanten en vertaal je hun commerciële doelstellingen naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën. Je combineert strategisch advies met een hands-on aanpak en ontwikkelt en optimaliseert campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok. Daarbij werk je met grote mediabudgetten en krijg je volop ruimte om impact te maken. AI speelt een belangrijke rol in jouw werk. Je benut slimme tools en automatisering om campagnes, content en processen continu te verbeteren. Daarnaast signaleer je proactief commerciële kansen bij klanten en deel je jouw kennis en ervaring met junior marketeers. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan het succes van klanten, maar ook aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team en de dienstverlening van Indicia.

Over Indicia

Indicia is een onafhankelijk tech, data en AI-bureau dat sinds 1996 organisaties helpt om digitaal te groeien. Vanuit de overtuiging dat succesvolle digitale oplossingen beginnen bij een goed begrip van de business, combineert Indicia technologie, data en ondernemerschap om organisaties verder te brengen.

Met ruim 250 digitale specialisten biedt Indicia een breed scala aan diensten, waaronder online marketing, webdevelopment, HubSpot, AI en design. Van het ontwikkelen van websites en digitale platforms tot het realiseren van effectieve marketingcampagnes en slimme automatiseringen. Indicia bedient klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren en richt zich steeds meer op grotere organisaties en langdurige samenwerkingen.

De organisatie bevindt zich in een fase van verdere professionalisering, waarbij de focus ligt op het verdiepen van specialismen, het versterken van de strategische klantrelaties en het realiseren van meetbare resultaten. AI speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Indicia ontwikkelt eigen AI-tools om processen slimmer en efficiënter in te richten, waardoor meer ruimte ontstaat voor strategisch advies, innovatie en klantontwikkeling.

De bedrijfscultuur is informeel, familiair en ondernemend. Collega's werken nauw samen, krijgen veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en worden gestimuleerd om zich zowel persoonlijk als professioneel te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd groeit de ambitie om resultaatgerichter te werken en als organisatie verder te professionaliseren.

https://www.indicia.ai/

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Ontwikkelen en presenteren van socialmediastrategieën voor grote klanten, waarbij je commerciële doelstellingen vertaalt naar concrete campagnes en meetbare resultaten;
  • Actief bijdragen aan commerciële voorstellen, pitches en pre-salesgesprekken, waarbij je klanten adviseert over de mogelijkheden van social advertising;
  • Fungeren als strategisch en inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, waarbij je periodiek campagneresultaten presenteert en proactief kansen voor upsell en cross-sell signaleert;
  • Zelfstandig opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van paid social campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok, inclusief het bewaken van instellingen, KPI's en budgetten;
  • Analyseren van campagneresultaten, uitvoeren van A/B-testen en continu verbeteren van performance, conversies en rendement;
  • Samenwerken met het interne AI-lab om AI en automatisering slim toe te passen binnen campagnes, contentcreatie, budgetoptimalisatie en werkprocessen;
  • Signaleren en toepassen van nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen social advertising en AI, waarbij je ook de verbinding legt met andere online marketingdisciplines, zoals SEO en SEA;
  • Coachen en begeleiden van junior social marketeers, kennis delen en bijdragen aan hun professionele ontwikkeling;
  • Aanbrengen van structuur, stimuleren van eigenaarschap en bewaken van de kwaliteit binnen het social team.

Jouw plek binnen de organisatie:

Als ervaren collega ben je een vraagbaak en sparringpartner voor de junior social marketeers. Je deelt je kennis over social en AI, en helpt hen zo verder te groeien. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Sophie Mees, Delivery Manager Online Marketing.

Requirements

Je bent een enthousiaste en ondernemende persoonlijkheid die energie brengt, initiatief neemt en het team weet mee te nemen in nieuwe ideeën. Je voelt je thuis in een informele en familiaire werkomgeving en draagt met jouw commerciële drive en resultaatgerichte instelling bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met paid social advertising, bij voorkeur binnen een groter marketingbureau, waarbij je gewend bent te werken met aanzienlijke mediabudgetten;
  • Uitgebreide kennis van advertentieplatforms zoals Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok en ervaring met het zelfstandig opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van campagnes;
  • Een analytische instelling en aantoonbare ervaring met campagneanalyse, A/B-testen en performanceoptimalisatie;
  • Een sterke strategische en commerciële blik, waarbij je businessdoelstellingen vertaalt naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën en kansen voor klantgroei signaleert;
  • Ervaring als strategisch gesprekspartner voor klanten op management- en directieniveau, gecombineerd met sterke communicatieve en presentatievaardigheden;
  • Een AI-minded en tech-savvy instelling, waarbij je AI actief inzet voor contentontwikkeling, campagneoptimalisatie en het automatiseren van werkprocessen;
  • Ervaring met het coachen en begeleiden van junior collega's en het delen van vakinhoudelijke kennis; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

Benefits

Bij Indicia kom je terecht in een informele en ambitieuze werkomgeving waar je de vrijheid krijgt om initiatief te nemen en écht impact te maken. Je werkt voor aansprekende klanten, krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren met de nieuwste AI-tools en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de dienstverlening.

  • Laptop van de zaak (MacBook of Windows);
  • Dagelijks lunch, regelmatig leuke borrels, en de (buitenlands) bedrijfstrip!

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline.

The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues.

You’ll be:

  • Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline.

  • Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch.

  • Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers.

  • Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand.

  • Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social.

  • Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them.

  • Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off.

  • Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

  • 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch.

  • Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs.

  • You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow.

  • A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it.

  • Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR.

  • A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams.

  • Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract.

  • A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures.

Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.

  

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.

We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.

Our Tech Stack

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.

 

Your role

In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.

  • Delivery: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. 
  • Direction: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.
  • Talent: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.
  • Culture: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.

    About the role

    At SkyNRG, we’re on a mission leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high‑integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF).     As an Intern within the Innovation team, you will perform research focused on the sustainability performance of innovative technology routes to SAF. During this internship, you will build a framework for Life Cycle Analysis of various SAF production routes and evaluate the GHG reduction potential and fit with European Policy frameworks for selected routes. You will work closely with a technically skilled and experienced Innovation team and report directly to our Senior Analyst, Dusita de Hoop.

    This internship offers the opportunity to apply academic knowledge in a real‑world context, collaborate with industry experts, and contribute to innovation at the forefront of sustainable aviation.

    Your Responsibilities:

    • Life Cycle Assessment: Build a framework to assess life cycle performance of various innovative SAF production routes.

    • GHG reduction calculation: Calculate the GHG reduction potential of selected SAF production routes

    • Policy Fit: asses the fit of selected SAF production routes with European SAF policy such as REFUELEU Aviation.

    • Team collaboration: Work closely with external partners, contributing findings, insights and ideas to ongoing research and development activities.

    Your profile

    • Master’s student with a background in science or engineering (enrolled for the full duration of the internship)

    • Strong interest in renewable fuels, energy transition or sustainable technologies

    • Experience or academic exposure with Life Cycle Analysis and GHG reduction calculations is a must. Able to work independently, strong analytical skillset and a structured approach to complex technical questions

    • Comfortable working with Excel, Word and PowerPoint

    • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

    • Full-time availability for a 6-month internship starting 15th of February 2027

    Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

    Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

    Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

    Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.
